one_liner: Gorgias has a broad REST API with Basic-auth API keys (all helpdesk plans), OAuth2 for public apps (requires app approval), and an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: API key (sent via HTTP Basic, email:API key) is for private apps only; OAuth2 authorization-code flow is mandatory for public apps, which need Gorgias partner signup and approval before appearing in the App Store. Access tokens expire after 24h; refresh tokens are used for renewal.
access_notes: API keys are self-serve to account owners/admins on any helpdesk plan, but a Gorgias account is a paid product. Multi-user OAuth2 requires a partner account and app review before public install.
blocker_notes: Multi-tenant OAuth2 requires a Gorgias partner account and approval of the public app. Per-customer API key (Basic) works immediately but needs a paid Gorgias account.

evidence.quote: Gorgias uses HTTP Basic Authentication with three pieces of information: your base API URL, your email address, and an API key.
